name: Azure Machine Learning
short_description: Azure Machine Learning is a Microsoft cloud service for managing the machine learning lifecycle, including training jobs, experiment tracking, model registration and managed batch and online endpoints.

evidence.quote: Azure Machine Learning can support this development work.
Azure Machine Learning is a workshop, not a robot.
Azure Machine Learning is a cloud service built to run the whole machine learning project from start to finish.
And it's available right in Azure Open Data sets, ready to load into Azure ML.
Azure Machine Learning can support this development work.
